UpgradeSession.description: Firmware-upgrade session record at RAM 0x20001490 in build 0159. Holds the transfer state flags, the progress and checksum words, and the 8-byte CBC-style chain and block words used by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler.

fields.name: busy
fields.description: Transfer-in-progress flag. vcu_fw_update_frame_handler clears it when it is non-zero and the session ends. vcu_crypto_key_load zeroes it.

fields.name: expected_seq
fields.description: Sequence number expected for the next sub-command 8 block. It is incremented per accepted block, and the previous sequence number is accepted silently.

fields.name: started
fields.description: Set to 1 when a transfer starts (sub-command 7). Blocks are rejected while it is 0. Probably means the staging area was erased.

fields.name: verified
fields.description: Set to 1 when the running checksum equals the word in the payload. Sub-command 9 requires it together with checksum_phase.

fields.name: checksum_phase
fields.description: Set to 1 once the checksum phase has been entered. Probably marks that the trailing words are being compared.

fields.name: key_is_default
fields.description: Set to 1 by vcu_crypto_key_load when the flash key slot equals the built-in default key, so the RAM key is the default. It is 0 when the key came from flash.

fields.name: xfer_size
fields.description: Size in bytes of the image being staged, set by sub-command 7. It must be non-zero, below 0xF000 and a multiple of 8. The erase covers size plus 0x80 bytes.

fields.name: xfer_progress
fields.description: Bytes accepted so far in the current transfer, advanced by 4 per payload word. It is also compared with 0x400 for the 1 KiB key step and the first-KiB checks.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: Rolling checksum over the image. Each step rotates the value by 16 bits, complements it and adds the next payload word. Sub-command 9 compares it with the expected word.

fields.name: block_count
fields.description: Number of 8-byte blocks in the transfer, rounded up from xfer_size. One of the two start branches counts one extra block.

fields.name: chain_lo
fields.description: Low word of the 8-byte XOR chain. Each 8-byte block XORs the payload with the chain (chain_lo and chain_hi) before decryption. It takes the value of block_word0 at the start of each block.

fields.name: chain_hi
fields.description: High word of the 8-byte XOR chain. It takes the value of block_word1 at the start of each block.

fields.name: block_word0
fields.description: First 4-byte word of the current 8-byte block, taken from payload bytes 5 to 8.

fields.name: block_word1
fields.description: Second 4-byte word of the current 8-byte block, taken from payload bytes 9 to 12.
